title: Case Analysis Method & Discovery — Request & Control Flow
purpose: Traces Case Study Technical Translation: converting business requirements into explicit GCP component choices via decision rubric.
routing_rationale: Systematic decision rubrics eliminate guesswork when matching high-level business goals to specific Google Cloud services.

nodes.label: 'Zero downtime global SQL database'
nodes.detail: Must maintain strong ACID consistency across North America and Europe.

nodes.label: Constraint: ACID + Global SQL
nodes.detail: Filters out NoSQL (Firestore/Bigtable) and single-region relational (Cloud SQL).

nodes.label: Cloud Spanner Multi-Region
nodes.detail: Globally distributed relational database delivering 99.999% SLA with external consistency.

steps.title: Constraint Filtering
steps.action: Applies technical constraints: relational SQL + multi-region consistency.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates Cloud SQL (single-region limit) and Bigtable (NoSQL).

steps.title: Product Confirmation
steps.action: Cloud Spanner identified as the only GCP service meeting all criteria.

scenarios.label: Selected Cloud SQL for Multi-Region Active-Active
scenarios.root_cause: Architect selected Cloud SQL with cross-region read replica, failing write availability in secondary region.
scenarios.diverted_path: Secondary region cannot accept writes during regional failover.
scenarios.recovery: Select Cloud Spanner Multi-Region when write availability is required across multiple regions.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
